Bill.BriefDescription: Excluding vehicles that have been demolished by a licensed scrap processor from the definition of "junk vehicle."

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the exclusion of certain vehicles from thedefinition of "junk vehicle"; and amending RCW 46.79.010.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.79.010 and 2001 c 64 s 10 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions set forth in this section apply throughout thischapter unless the context indicates otherwise. (1)(a) "Junk vehicle" means a motor vehicle certified under RCW46.55.230 as meeting all the following requirements: (((a))) (i) Is three years old or older; (((b))) (ii) Is extensively damaged, such damage including but notlimited to any of the following: A broken window or windshield ormissing wheels, tires, motor, or transmission; (((c))) (iii) Is apparently inoperable; (((d))) (iv) Is without a valid, current registration plate; (((e))) (v) Has a fair market value equal only to the value of thescrap in it. (b) "Junk vehicle" does not include, for the purposes of thischapter, a vehicle that has been demolished by a licensed scrap p. 1 SB 6059processor. Such a vehicle is considered a commodity if beingtransported by a commercial motor vehicle in compliance with rulesadopted pursuant to chapters 46.16 and 46.32 RCW. (2) "Scrap processor" means a licensed establishment that maintainsa crusher, a hydraulic baler and shears, or a shredder for recyclingsalvage. (3) "Demolish" means to destroy completely by use of a crusher, ahydraulic baler and shears, or a shredder. (4) "Hulk hauler" means any person who deals in vehicles for thesole purpose of transporting and/or selling them to a licensed vehiclewrecker or scrap processor in substantially the same form in which theyare obtained. A hulk hauler may not sell secondhand motor vehicleparts to anyone other than a licensed vehicle wrecker or scrapprocessor, except for those parts specifically enumerated in RCW46.79.020(2), as now or hereafter amended, which may be sold to alicensed vehicle wrecker or disposed of at a public facility for wastedisposal. (5) "Director" means the director of licensing. (6) "Major component parts" include engines and short blocks,frames, transmissions or transfer cases, cabs, doors, front or reardifferentials, front or rear clips, quarter panels or fenders, bumpers,truck beds or boxes, seats, and hoods.
